page.overview:
Who is Nevaldine?

Soha Sirrendrin was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in Arrakeen. They asked him if it was a CHOAM vendor and he replied that it was before suspiciously asking if they were from the Committee on Interstallar Traffic and Trade or if Lady Nevaldine had put it up to it.
